verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly offer an API, bulk feed, or scriptable filing interface, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only a browser portal behind a standard Sign In / Create an Account login. Probes found the sos.state.mn.us front door and the DOR e-services rail served Radware Bot Manager CAPTCHA walls to keyless clients. The only automation-adjacent item is a bare 'Data and Image Subscriptions' title with no detail on machine delivery, so nothing shows headless or CI operation is supported.
